tasks.label: AdBoard: Deploy to Joomla container
tasks.detail: Syncs src/ into the running joomla_app container. Override JOOMLA_CONTAINER/JOOMLA_ROOT via env if yours differ.

tasks.label: AdBoard: Build + Deploy
tasks.detail: One-keypress daily loop: rebuild the package, then sync source into the running container. Ctrl+Shift+B.

tasks.label: Docker: Up (build)
tasks.detail: First run, or after changing the Dockerfile/compose. Builds the Xdebug image and starts all containers.

tasks.label: Docker: Start
tasks.detail: Resume the stack where you left off (keeps all data).

tasks.label: Docker: Stop
tasks.detail: Gracefully stop the stack (keeps all data).

tasks.label: Docker: Down
tasks.detail: Stop AND remove containers (named volumes joomla_data/db_data are kept). Add -v to wipe data.
